maddeler.e:
تستلبوا (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِبُوا (tastalibū) /tas.ta.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# تُسْتَلَبُوا (tustalabū) /tus.ta.la.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
